Double Down.description: Allow Every Role To Pick The Same Target Twice.

Guarenteed Roles.description: Have Specific Roles (Sheriff and Doctor) Always In The Game.

Drunk.description: On Good or Neutral Role Becomes Drunk At The Start Of The Game, Their Role Will Not Function Properly Unless They Are Poisoned

Testing Role.description: Shuffle The Testing Role Into The Game.

Instant Death.description: The Gambler Has A Chance of Rolling Instant Death. If They Are Not Protected, Poisoned or Drunk On The Turn They Roll This, They Die.
